description: Shape every benchmark run must emit so the harness can grade it and the artifact can render the chain of events. The trace is the point: it shows which Evergreen data was pulled and which playbook skill fired, in order.

run.pipeline_fired: yes | no  (derived: did every required_skill appear in trace as kind=skill)
run.answer: for MCQ cases: the chosen option token (e.g. 'b', 'omit', 'authority', 'do_not_ship'); else null

output.text: the raw final output the strategist would see

variants.enrichment: the Clay var / enrichment paying for the rung
variants.winner_ref: the logged winner this models (id or label), if any
variants.loser_ref: nearest logged loser + why_it_failed, if benchmarked
variants.mechanism: the mechanism line used, or null if omitted

trace.name: GET /api/clients/leadgenix/call-insights
trace.result_summary: n terminology, n angles, n objections
